A.summary: Complete connectivity, credible USB and PCIe geometry on the stated stack, and broad power distribution make A the best release candidate. Ethernet P0 has 4.64 mm of skew and asymmetric vias, and drilled M.2 solder lands need an assembly decision.

B.summary: B has 147 missing connections, including power, ground, reset and the RP2040 USB D+ path. C5 and C51 physically overlap U3 on the front side.

C.summary: C has complete connectivity, consistently paired Ethernet and PCIe, and well-grouped drive regulators. The stated stack misses the USB impedance target, and tracks pass only 0.0501 mm from an RJ45 locating hole.

D.summary: D combines strong power copper, local return stitching and one-sided assembly with zero opens. A PCIe receive pair has 8.79 mm of skew, and a refill changes edge clearance while leaving 19 same-net zone intersections.

human_guess.why: The one-sided assembly, individually shaped converter copper, local thermal and return vias, visible indicators and selective arc-based tuning suggest a human balancing assembly, power and routing tradeoffs.
